units: mm; levels are structural slab levels (SSL) relative to datum +00 = existing ground level (general note 2, p3)

storey_heights_mm: +300 to +3900 = 3600; every storey above = 3300. Elevations show slab 200 thick at ground and roof, 175 at other floors, beams 425 below slab soffit (600 overall).

materials.reinforcement: H = high tensile fy 500 N/mm2; R = mild steel 250 N/mm2 - p3

foundations.formation: General note 1 (p3): formation level below natural (existing) ground level for all bases unless otherwise stated; datum for existing ground = +00. Every base section (p7-p11) and section 01-01 on p4 shows: 150 ground-bearing slab (BRC A252 mesh 50 from top) + 300 hardcore + 1500 + 1900 (1800/2000/3300 for some types) + base thickness = 4450 from top of the +300 slab to underside of base, i.e. underside of base at -4150 (blinding to -4200). Raft: top -3300, 300 thick, underside -3600, blinding -3650.
foundations.bearing_note: 'An estimated bearing capacity of 400 kN/m2 at 4.0 m depth was used in the design of the foundation as given by the Geotechnical investigation report' (p3).
foundations.founding_level_note: founding_level_mm below is derived (+300 - 4450 = -4150); the drawings never print it. Base sections are the same generic section for bases inside the basement footprint, where the floor is at -3300 and the raft underside at -3600, so those pads would project ~550 below the raft underside - the drawings do not show this junction.

continuity_legend.legend: p4/p5/p6 legend: filled red = CONTINUOUS COLUMN, hollow = TERMINATED COLUMN, red X box = SUMP, black X = OPENING IN CORE WALL
terminated_as_drawn: C5a at B/1A is drawn hollow on p4, p5 and p18 (filled on p19 at +300), so it starts at +300 on the B retaining wall line. It has no pad base.
continuity_legend.continuous_as_drawn: Every other column on p4/p5 is drawn filled, including C4 (stops at +3900), C5 (stops at +10500) and C2/C3 (stop at +23700). The hollow/filled symbol therefore does not show where a column stops at the top; use the elevations (p12/p13).
continuity_legend.sump: The SUMP symbol is in the legend, but no red-X sump appears on p4 or p5. Lift shaft interiors (D-E/5-6, J-K/5-6) carry a black X and are marked VOID on p6.
continuity_legend.basement_extent: Basement (raft top -3300) inside the retaining walls: B-B2/1B-2, B-C/2-7, plus underground water tank C-D/3-5. Ramp labelled south of grid 7 between C and D (p6). Swimming pool on the ground floor in the B1-B2/4-7 area (p20, not transcribed).

unreadable_or_ambiguous: The drawings never print a founding level. -4150 is derived from the 4450 base-section depth below the +300 slab. Pads under the basement-wall columns (B2 at B/2A and C/2A, B4, B5, B6, B7, B13, B15) use the same generic section, even though the floor there is the -3300 raft. Their real depth and connection to the raft are not shown.
Base counts: B2 detail says 10 No. but p4 shows 8; B3 says 3 No. but p4 shows 2.

B14 bars: '2x85-H2007 B2&T2 @100' cannot fit a 4025 base. The schedule H2007 48 / H2008 54 (each = total) fits neither base nor count. Read as H20@100 both ways, top and bottom; counts unreliable. The wall link mark H1612 is not in the schedule.
B12: column starters 18-H20 (section 16-16) vs C1b 18-H25 at +300 to +3900. Schedule H2001 = 28 does not match 20 wall + 18 column.
B13: three columns (C2, C3, C4) but starters are detailed and scheduled for two only.
B15: plan '2x20-H2007' vs schedule 72 H2007 and 72 H2008. The SW rectangle width (~2250) is scaled from p4 (925 + 1325), not dimensioned on the detail.
B6 both mat labels read B1&T1; B7 plan H2002 vs schedule H2004 (both H20).
C6 at +3900 to +7200: elevation 18-H2001 (H20) vs schedule implying 18-H25 (H2502). The diameter matters.
Section bar labels disagree with the elevations for C1a (03-03: mixed H25/H20; 04-04: 12-H20 + 2-H16) and C1b (05-05 side bars H2001). The elevation/schedule counts are used.
C5 schedule (links 135, H1601 12) implies more storeys than the 3-storey elevation. C5 orientation: B1 detail 400(x)x200(y) vs p5 200(x)x400(y).
C7: detail says 1 No.; p24 shows two. C5b is only on p19.
Top-storey bar marks (H2001 vs H2002, H1601 vs H1602) differ between elevation and schedule for SW2, SW3, SW5 and SW7. The diameter is the same, so this does not change capacity.
Raft: N-S marks H1601/H1602 are scheduled as 12 mm. Some raft schedule cut lengths do not match the zones. The zone-to-label mapping is approximate.
Tie beam level: p6 title says -1500, but the p4 section geometry gives ~-1650 (top of beam 1950 below the +300 slab top).
Level naming conflict: +300 is 'SUB-BASEMENT FLOOR' on p12-p15/p19 but 'BASEMENT FLR +300' on p17. p18 'BASEMENT FLOOR' is -3300. Roof printed '+2700'.
The panel marked with a large black X between G and H (from ~1350 S of grid 3 to grid 7) on the p6 tie-beam plan is unlabelled. It has no tie beams or earth fill inside; purpose not identified.
The basement storey (-3300 to +300) of the free-standing C4 columns, and the C5b anchorage beam at +300, are not detailed on the column sheets.
structural_observations: Columns stopping short of the roof: C4 at +3900; C5, C5a and C5b at +10500; C2 (6 No.), C3, SW4 and SW6 at +23700. SW5 reduces from a 1500x300 wall to a 600x300 column above +23700. Only C1, C1a, C1b, C6, the two lift cores, SW5 (as a column) and SW7 reach +27000.

Transfer / planted columns: C7 (600x200) starts on the fifth floor slab at +20400 beside a hidden beam 175x600 (two locations on p24). C5b (400x200) starts at +300 on a 600x300 beam over the basement wing (B1/1, B1/2).
Bar reductions: C1 and C2/C3 drop from 18-H20 to 18-H16 at +7200. C1a and C1b drop from H25 to H20 at +7200. C6 drops from H25 to H20 at +3900 (or +7200 per schedule).
C1b: 18-H25 in 600x300 is 4.9% (9.8% at the 1750 laps), above the usual 4%/8% limits. C1a: 14-H25 is 3.8% (7.6% at laps).
Row 3 C1 columns (6 No.) sit on 2500x2500x600 pads with a bottom mat only. Row 5/7 columns sit on 3500x3500x700 pads. At 400 kPa a B2 pad allows ~2500 kN service.
B9 (under C1 at F/5 and C2 at N/5, N/7) has a bottom mat only. The otherwise identical B10 (C1 at H/5) has top and bottom mats.
SW4, SW6 and SW7 are single isolated 1500/2625 x 300 walls on their own bases. The two lift cores (2825 x 2625, 300 walls) are the main lateral elements on B14 (4225x4025x700).
The basement / underground water tank (raft top -3300) is enclosed by 300 RC retaining walls. Columns C2, C3, C1a, C5a and SW5 are embedded in the wall lines.
